fieldValues.title: Registry
fieldValues.extension_adds: A published, discoverable catalog of Field, Type and other definitions that a multi-publisher ecosystem can index. It states no opinion on registry authority, authentication or federation between competing catalogs; a consumer may index more than one.
fieldValues.extension_cost_of_non_adoption: Without it, Field, Type and other definitions have no published, discoverable catalog for a multi-publisher ecosystem to index; a consumer has no registry to look up an unfamiliar definition against.
